topic: Mobile stations and alternative energy (G4E; 11 pool questions)

questions.question: What is the purpose of a capacitance hat on a mobile antenna?

choices.A: To increase the power handling capacity of a whip antenna
choices.C: To electrically lengthen a physically short antenna

questions.answer: To electrically lengthen a physically short antenna

questions.question: What is the purpose of a corona ball on an HF mobile antenna?

choices.A: To narrow the operating bandwidth of the antenna
choices.B: To increase the “Q” of the antenna
choices.C: To reduce the chance of damage if the antenna should strike an object
choices.D: To reduce RF voltage discharge from the tip of the antenna while transmitting

questions.answer: To reduce RF voltage discharge from the tip of the antenna while transmitting

questions.question: Which of the following direct, fused power connections would be the best for a 100-watt HF mobile installation?

choices.A: To the battery using heavy-gauge wire
choices.B: To the alternator or generator using heavy-gauge wire
choices.C: To the battery using insulated heavy duty balanced transmission line
choices.D: To the alternator or generator using insulated heavy duty balanced transmission line

questions.answer: To the battery using heavy-gauge wire

questions.question: Why should DC power for a 100-watt HF transceiver not be supplied by a vehicle’s auxiliary power socket?

choices.A: The socket is not wired with an RF-shielded power cable
choices.B: The socket’s wiring may be inadequate for the current drawn by the transceiver
choices.C: The DC polarity of the socket is reversed from the polarity of modern HF transceivers
choices.D: Drawing more than 50 watts from this socket could cause the engine to overheat

questions.answer: The socket’s wiring may be inadequate for the current drawn by the transceiver

questions.question: Which of the following most limits an HF mobile installation?

choices.B: The wire gauge of the DC power line to the transceiver
choices.C: Efficiency of the electrically short antenna
choices.D: FCC rules limiting mobile output power on the 75-meter band

questions.answer: Efficiency of the electrically short antenna

questions.question: What is one disadvantage of using a shortened mobile antenna as opposed to a full-size antenna?

choices.A: Short antennas are more likely to cause distortion of transmitted signals
choices.B: Q of the antenna will be very low
choices.C: Operating bandwidth may be very limited

questions.answer: Operating bandwidth may be very limited

questions.question: Which of the following may cause receive interference to an HF transceiver installed in a vehicle?
In what configuration are the individual cells in a solar panel connected together?
What is the approximate open-circuit voltage from a fully illuminated silicon photovoltaic cell?
Why should a series diode be connected between a solar panel and a storage battery that is being charged by the panel?

choices.A: To prevent overload by regulating the charging voltage
choices.B: To prevent discharge of the battery through the panel during times of low or no illumination
choices.C: To limit the current flowing from the panel to a safe value
choices.D: To prevent damage to the battery due to excessive voltage at high illumination levels

questions.answer: To prevent discharge of the battery through the panel during times of low or no illumination

questions.question: What precaution should be taken when connecting a solar panel to a lithium iron phosphate battery?

choices.A: Ground the solar panel outer metal framework
choices.B: Ensure the battery is placed terminals-up
choices.C: A series resistor must be in place
choices.D: The solar panel must have a charge controller

questions.answer: The solar panel must have a charge controller
